channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: Trump waives broad new Russia sanctions and tariffs under Graham Act, citing national interest
item.description: Trump signed the Graham Bill, which targeted Russia over its invasion of Ukraine, into law in September.

item.title: Nasdaq slides 2% Friday to post worst week since June, pressured by AI sell-off and oil prices: Live updates
item.description: Investors shunned the artificial intelligence trade and oil prices spiked on Friday, dragging the three major averages to losses.

item.title: IMF members call for more support amid war shocks, 'advanced intelligence' risks
item.description: "Escalating conflicts and trade tensions could further disrupt critical trade routes," the chair of the International Monetary and Financial Committee said.

item.title: U.S. budget deficit swells to almost $2 trillion for fiscal 2026, up 12% in a single year
item.description: The Treasury Department published the U.S. budget deficit for the 2026 fiscal year.

item.title: Some companies give AI to everyone. This CEO is doing the opposite
item.description: Paysend CEO Ben Chisell limits AI tools to top performers as other U.K. companies push broader workplace rollouts.

item.title: Major earnings reports are due next week, but strong results may not be enough to quell market fears
item.description: Reports from Meta Platforms and Procter & Gamble are on deck as investors grow wary of the market.

item.title: Apple’s $1,999 iPhone Duo puts the company's status-symbol power to the test
item.description: Apple’s $1,999 iPhone Duo is drawing early demand as analysts assess whether the foldable can lift iPhone pricing and revenue.

item.title: Wall Street's fear gauge is ripping. Traders see it going even higher
item.description: The sell-off in AI-related stocks pushed the VIX above 22 for the first time in four months. A cluster of trades suggests it could go even higher.

item.title: Katie Zacharia out as Trump's White House press secretary
item.description: Zacharia was on shaky ground from her first White House press conference and over questions about her claims of being a lawyer despite not passing a bar exam.

item.title: Why Trump and the GOP's billion-dollar midterm blitz isn’t working
item.description: Trump-aligned groups and Elon Musk have poured hundreds of millions into the midterm election, but the GOP spending surge has barely moved polls or the map.

item.title: Tesla unveils long-delayed Roadster developed with SpaceX, fueling merger speculation
item.description: Elon Musk first debuted the Roadster refresh concept in 2017 but Tesla has since missed every targeted delivery date.

item.title: Prediction market odds on Tesla-SpaceX merger are above 50% for early 2027
item.description: Kalshi odds for a Tesla-SpaceX merger rose above 50% for early 2027 as Barclays outlined how a deal could work.

item.title: U.S. presses China on Mastercard, Citigroup market access in bilateral Bangkok talks, official says
item.description: The U.S. raised market access issues for Mastercard and Citigroup in China during bilateral meetings in Bangkok this week, a U.S. Treasury official says.

item.title: Trump says White House didn't order Starlink restrictions in Ukraine
item.description: Ukrainian officials complained this week that SpaceX had limited internet connectivity without advance notice.

item.title: Looking for a non-AI trade? This bank stock is poised for a breakout next week
item.description: For JPMorgan, the upside potential appears greater than the downside risk.

item.title: Here's who Netflix just brought in to run content — and what it means for the streamer
item.description: Peter Rice brings a wealth of experience in TV and film, including scripted and unscripted shows, live sports, prestige television and theatrical distribution.

item.title: The Austin Powers steamroller: How to trade CoreWeave's slow moving crisis
item.description: After a 27.5% drop from last Friday's close to this Thursday morning's 52-week lows, followed by a 17% rebound, equity traders holding CoreWeave are dazed.

item.title: Analysis: Why a $2 trillion deficit and 5% Treasury yields are becoming America's biggest economic challenge
item.description: Treasury yields above 5% are raising borrowing costs for households and the federal government, highlighting the challenge of financing $2 trillion deficits.

item.title: OpenAI Saudi national bugging case shows threat to U.S. leadership in AI: DNI Clayton
item.description: AI "amplifies" existing cybersecurity risks toward U.S. digital infrastructure, Clayton said on "Squawk Box."

item.title: Debt is eating up a bigger chunk of your raise, research shows
item.description: New research finds debt payments rose far faster than estimated real household income, absorbing about half of a one-earner household's gains.

item.title: Why did CoreWeave stock get crushed this week? Look to this corner of the debt market for clues
item.description: CoreWeave’s bond yields and credit default swaps have surged as its stock sells off. Here’s what those credit signals mean for stock investors.

item.title: What happens after bankruptcy? A debt attorney explains what comes next
item.description: Learn what happens after bankruptcy, how it affects your credit, plus steps to rebuild with guidance from a debt attorney.

item.title: Here's how the CoreWeave sell-off is affecting OpenAI vs. Anthropic valuations
item.description: The spread is widening between AI leaders OpenAI and Anthropic as a sell-off in CoreWeave leads neocloud stocks lower.

item.title: NBA tightens betting rules, develops AI to flag suspicious wagers
item.description: The NBA is tightening restrictions on bets and deploying AI to help identify suspicious wagering, according to two documents obtained by CNBC.

item.title: Elon Musk cash infusion helps GOP Senate super PAC raise record $273 million
item.description: Elon Musk gave a record $158 million to the GOP’s Senate Leadership Fund, boosting its war chest as Republicans pour money into Texas to defend Ken Paxton.

item.title: SpaceX AI policy leader grilled by NYC Council on Grok safety, sexualized images
item.description: SpaceX head of global government affairs for AI Gabriela Castillo Madrid faced critical questions from the New York City Council on Friday.

item.title: Schwab to create 'tax-aware' strategy that's been attracting billions from wealthy investors
item.description: Wealthy investors are flocking to tax-aware long short strategies, adding billions into these super-powered versions of tax-loss harvesting accounts.

item.title: I watched Nvidia's Jensen Huang work the room in London. He brought big checks — and a blunt message
item.description: Nvidia has a near monopoly over the most powerful AI chips and Huang courts tech execs and world leaders with ease.

item.title: The affordability crisis isn't hitting all voters equally. Here's why
item.description: Younger Americans face higher inflation and housing costs than baby boomers, widening the affordability divide ahead of the 2026 midterm elections.

item.title: Blue Origin plans $330 million Florida expansion to ramp New Glenn launches
item.description: Blue Origin said it's targeting multiple flights per week of its New Glenn rocket by the end of the decade.
